app.title: PromptRank
app.subtitle: CSV Phase 1: import, mapping, and normalized products.

home.title: Normalize a product catalog from a CSV.
home.description: Create a project, upload your CSV file, map your columns, and review normalized products before the next phases.
home.scopeText: This version covers the CSV flow. Shopify, AI, scoring, prompts, and action cards are not included in this phase.

projectCreate.title: New CSV project
projectCreate.description: Enter the minimum catalog context. These details help normalize imported products.
projectCreate.submitHelp: You will be redirected to CSV upload after creation.

errors.minlength: The name must contain at least 3 characters.
errors.maxlength: The name must be 80 characters or fewer.

primaryLanguage.label: Primary language
primaryLanguage.help: Required. Phase 1: use fr or en.

errors.pattern: Use fr or en for Phase 1.

targetCountry.label: Target country
targetCountry.help: Required. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format, for example FR, BE, or US.

errors.pattern: Use two uppercase letters, for example FR.

currency.label: Currency
currency.help: Required. ISO 4217 format, for example EUR, USD, or GBP.

errors.pattern: Use three uppercase letters, for example EUR.

csvUpload.title: Upload the CSV file
csvUpload.description: Select the product catalog to analyze. The backend will also validate the file; these checks guide you before upload.
csvUpload.dropHelp: Select a file from your computer.
csvUpload.submitHelp: Analysis detects the delimiter, columns, and prepares the preview.
csvUpload.sampleHelp: A sample file is available at samples/products-demo.csv.

constraints.delimiters: Supported delimiters: comma, semicolon, and tab.

csvPreview.title: CSV preview
csvPreview.description: Quickly check the detected structure before mapping columns.
csvPreview.tableHelp: The preview shows only the first 20 rows of the file.
csvPreview.empty: Upload a CSV to generate a preview.

csvMapping.title: Column mapping
csvMapping.description: Map each CSV column to a normalized product field. The title field is required before import.
csvMapping.titleRequiredHelp: The title field must be mapped before importing products.
csvMapping.unmappedHelp: These columns will not appear in the main table, but they will be preserved in the product attributes.
csvMapping.recommendedWarningText: {{fields}} are not mapped. You can still import, but these details will be less visible in the product table.
csvMapping.saveAndImportNote: The mapping shown here will be saved before import.
csvMapping.empty: Go back to CSV upload to generate a mapping.
csvMapping.recommendedText: title is required. For a more useful table, also map these fields when your CSV contains them.

recommended.url: url to find the source product page
recommended.taxonomy: brand, category, or productType to structure the catalog

summary.title: Summary before import
summary.help: Review the key points before starting the import.
